en: 24-hour onsite service · urgent attendance from 30 minutes*
Call our Perth team to arrange a visit
zh: 24 小时上门服务 · 紧急上门最快 30 分钟*
联系珀斯团队，安排上门服务

en: *Subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control.
zh: *具体取决于地点、安全通行条件及不可控因素。

en: Urgent callouts: Ellis can arrange attendance in as little as 30 minutes. We provide 24-hour onsite service, subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control.
Need an urgent repair? Call our Perth team to discuss the problem and arrange a visit.
zh: 紧急上门：Ellis 最快可在 30 分钟内安排人员到场。我们提供 24 小时现场服务，具体取决于地点、能否安全进场，以及我们无法控制的情况。
需要紧急维修？请致电珀斯团队，说明问题并安排上门。

en: Urgent attendance can be arranged in as little as 30 minutes, and 24-hour onsite service is available subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control.
For urgent repairs, call us to discuss the problem and arrange a visit.
zh: 紧急上门最快可在 30 分钟内安排；24 小时现场服务须视地点、安全进场条件及我们无法控制的情况而定。
如需紧急维修，请致电说明问题并安排上门。

en: Urgent callouts can be arranged in as little as 30 minutes. Ellis provides 24-hour onsite service, subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control.
Need an urgent repair? Call us to discuss the problem and arrange a visit.
zh: 紧急上门最快可在 30 分钟内安排。Ellis 提供 24 小时上门服务，具体取决于地点、安全通行条件及不可控因素。
需要紧急维修？请致电说明问题并安排上门。

en: Available 24 hours, subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control.
Call us to arrange your visit.
zh: 提供 24 小时服务，具体取决于地点、安全进场条件及我们无法控制的情况。
请致电安排上门。

en: As little as 30 minutes
Call to arrange a visit
zh: 最快 30 分钟
致电安排上门

en: Urgent attendance from 30 minutes
Discuss an urgent repair
zh: 紧急上门最快30分钟起
咨询紧急维修

en: Ellis provides 24-hour onsite service across Perth, subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control.
Call our Perth team to discuss your repair and arrange a visit.
zh: Ellis 在珀斯提供24小时现场服务，具体取决于位置、安全进场及我们无法控制的情况。
致电珀斯团队，咨询维修并安排上门。

en: Urgent attendance can be arranged from 30 minutes, subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control; confirm the visit time with our team.
Call our team to discuss an urgent door repair and arrange a visit.
zh: 紧急上门最快可从 30 分钟起安排，须视地点、安全进场条件及我们无法控制的情况而定；请与团队确认到访时间。
请致电团队，咨询紧急门维修并安排上门。

en: This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.
Tell us what needs attention. We will arrange an on-site assessment and discuss the repair with you.
zh: 本指南仅供一般参考，实际情况因物业而异。请联系 Ellis Services Group，安排由适合该项工作的专业人员进行现场评估。
请告诉我们需要处理的问题。我们会安排上门检查，与您沟通维修方案。

en: Cosmetic preparation is not a promise of a sale price, faster sale or a defect-free inspection.
zh: 外观准备并不保证售价、出售速度或检查无缺陷。

en: Ellis confirms the accepted appointment directly; a requested day or a website enquiry does not reserve a slot.
We will discuss your preferred time and confirm the appointment with you.
zh: Ellis 会直接确认接受的预约；提出某一天或网站咨询并不预留时段。
我们会与您沟通方便的时间，并确认预约。

en: A half-day request or urgent label does not establish job duration, a guaranteed arrival or a completed repair by that deadline.
We will discuss the work, materials and available appointment with you.
zh: 申请半天服务或标注紧急，不代表已确定工期、保证到场或保证期限前修好。
我们会与您沟通维修内容、材料及可安排的上门时间。

en: It also explains why grouping jobs can help planning without guaranteeing a lower total or a particular appointment.
It also explains how to group suitable repairs and prepare for a visit.
zh: 也说明合并工作可帮助规划，但不保证总价更低或特定预约。
同时介绍如何合并安排合适的维修项目，并为上门做好准备。

en: Bundling compatible repairs may reduce repeated setup, but does not guarantee a discount.
Grouping suitable repairs helps us plan the visit and identify shared preparation.
zh: 合并相容维修可能减少重复准备，但不保证折扣。
合并合适的维修项目，有助于我们安排上门并统筹准备工作。

en: Comparing those details is more informative than comparing totals alone, and bundling does not guarantee a discount.
Compare the included work, materials and finishing alongside the total price.
zh: 比较这些细节比只比总价更有用，合并也不保证折扣。
比较总价时，也请一并核对包含的工作、材料和收尾要求。

en: The repair record documents the work; it does not guarantee a bond refund, replace a statutory inspection or determine responsibility for damage.
We provide repair details for your property records and handover.
zh: 维修记录仅记载工作，不保证退押金、不替代法定检查，也不决定损害责任；这些事项有各自授权流程。
我们会提供维修记录，方便您存档和交接。

en: Photos help when available, but they do not decide liability or guarantee a bond outcome.
Existing photos can help us understand the repair list.
zh: 照片有则可辅助，不能决定责任或保证押金结果。
现有照片可帮助我们了解维修清单。

en: Repair work does not determine whether your bond will be returned.
zh: 维修工作不决定押金是否退还。

en: An end-of-lease clean is a defined service, not a guarantee of an inspection or bond result.
We confirm the cleaning checklist and quote with you before work begins.
zh: 退租清洁是范围明确的服务，不保证验房或押金退还结果。
我们会在开工前与您确认清洁清单和报价。

en: We agree the work and required finish with you; we do not guarantee an inspection or sale result.
We agree the repair work and required finish with you.
zh: 我们会与您商定工程和所需饰面，但不保证检查或房屋出售结果。
我们会与您确认维修内容及所需的完成效果。

en: A repair booking does not guarantee a bond refund.
zh: 预约维修不保证退还租赁押金。

en: A repair booking does not guarantee a bond refund or an inspection result.
zh: 预约维修不保证押金退还或检查结果。

en: We quote for the agreed repairs; this is not a guarantee about a bond refund or inspection outcome.
We confirm the approved repairs, finish and written quote with you.
zh: 我们按商定维修报价，不保证押金退还或检查结果。
我们会与您确认获准的维修内容、完成效果及书面报价。

en: A defined repair list is not an unlimited package or an inspection guarantee. Surface repairs do not establish the absence of concealed defects. Vacate repairs do not guarantee a bond refund or inspection result; pre-sale repairs do not promise a sale outcome.
We assess your repair list, explain the work and finishing options, and provide a written quote for the tasks you approve.
zh: 明确的维修清单并非无限服务套餐，也不是检查结果保证。表面修复不能证明不存在隐蔽缺陷。退租维修不保证押金退还或验收结果；售前维修不承诺出售结果。
我们会检查您的维修清单，说明维修及收尾方案，并为您认可的项目提供书面报价。

en: A preferred date does not confirm attendance or completion.
We will discuss your deadline and confirm the appointment with you.
zh: 期望日期不等于已确认上门或完工。
我们会与您沟通期限，并确认上门预约。

en: A maintenance quote records the work Ellis agrees to complete. It does not determine a rental inspection, sale presentation or bond decision.
We provide a written quote detailing the agreed repairs.
zh: 保养维修报价记录 Ellis 同意完成的工作，并不决定租房检查、售房展示或押金结果。
我们会提供书面报价，列明商定的维修内容。

en: No additional suburb coverage or local office is implied by this page.
Tell us your suburb or postcode so we can discuss the visit with you.
zh: 本页不表示还有其他城区覆盖或本地办事处。
请告知所在城区或邮编，方便我们与您沟通上门安排。

en: The photographs do not establish hidden fixing details, the wall construction or a tested load capacity.
zh: 照片无法确定隐蔽固定细节、墙体构造或经测试的承重能力。

en: The photographs do not establish drainage performance during rain.
zh: 照片无法确定雨中排水性能。

en: The photographs do not establish the condition of concealed post footings.
zh: 照片不能确定隐蔽立柱基础状况。

en: The roofline and gutter example shows visible work details, not proof of a hidden drainage condition.
View the roofline and gutter example to see the completed work.
zh: 这项 屋檐与天沟实例 展示可见工作细节，不能证明隐蔽排水状况。
查看屋檐与排水槽案例，了解完成后的维修效果。

en: This example shows bathroom tile and grout work, not proof of shower-screen glass replacement or hardware repair.
View our bathroom tile and grout repair example.
zh: 这个案例展示浴室瓷砖与勾缝工作，并非淋浴屏玻璃更换或五金维修的证明。
查看我们的浴室瓷砖与填缝维修案例。

en: Ellis confirms the appropriate personnel and deliverables for the brief without assuming a particular individual's credentials.
We confirm the appropriate team and deliverables for your project.
zh: Ellis 会确认符合要求的人员及交付内容，不预设某位个人的资质。
我们会为您的项目确认合适的团队及交付内容。

en: We confirm suitable tasks, approvals and visit arrangements; an enquiry does not establish ongoing attendance.
We discuss the maintenance tasks, approvals and visit schedule with you.
zh: 我们确认适合的任务、审批及到访安排；一次咨询并不自动建立长期服务安排。
我们会与您沟通维护项目、审批要求和上门安排。

en: Ellis confirms the assessment appointment and access directly, then checks the affected items on site.
We confirm your appointment and access arrangements, then check the affected items on site.
zh: Ellis 会直接与您确认评估预约及进场安排，再到现场检查相关部位。
我们会与您确认上门时间及进入安排，再到现场检查需要维修的项目。

en: What a maintenance list does not establish
Your repair plan
zh: 维护清单不能替代什么
您的维修方案

en: Those decisions follow their own authorised processes.
zh: 这些事项有各自授权流程。

en: Keep the accepted scope and identify who can approve a variation if the findings change; a request or preferred date does not itself confirm a booking.
Keep the agreed scope and approval contact handy. We will confirm the appointment and discuss any changes with you.
zh: 保留已接受范围，并明确发现情况改变时谁能批准变更；提交需求或期望日期本身不代表预约确认。
请保留商定的维修范围及审批联系人资料。我们会与您确认预约，并沟通需要变更的事项。

en: New silicone should not be presented as a guaranteed cure for a leak whose source has not been identified.
We assess the source of a leak before recommending surface resealing or further wet-area repairs.
zh: 漏源未明时，不能将新胶宣传为保证治好漏水。
我们会先检查漏水原因，再建议接缝重封或进一步的湿区维修。

en: New silicone should not be offered as a guaranteed cure for an unidentified leak.
If moisture points to a deeper problem, we discuss the further investigation and repairs needed.
zh: 漏源不明时，新胶不应被承诺为必然解决办法。
如潮湿迹象涉及更深层问题，我们会与您沟通所需的进一步检查和维修。

en: Matching a colour name alone does not guarantee a match.
We compare the colour with the existing coating and discuss the finishing area with you.
zh: 仅匹配颜色名称不保证效果相同。
我们会将颜色与现有漆面进行比较，并与您商定收尾区域。

en: Colour matching alone does not guarantee an invisible patch on weathered or aged paint.
Weathering and age can affect how a touch-up blends with the surrounding paint.
zh: 仅配色不能保证老化或风化漆面上的补块不可见。
风化和老化程度会影响补漆与周边漆面的融合效果。

en: A lower-impact method may suit fragile finishes; cleaning does not guarantee stain removal or an inspection outcome.
We assess the stains and surface condition, then discuss a suitable cleaning method, including gentler options for fragile finishes.
zh: 易损饰面可能适合较温和方法；清洁不保证去除污渍或通过检查。
我们会检查污渍及表面状况，再与您沟通合适的清洁方法，包括适用于易损饰面的温和方案。

en: Ellis separates patch preparation and painting in the scope and discusses local touch-up versus a wider repaint. An exact invisible match is not guaranteed.
We identify patch preparation and painting in the quote, then discuss a local touch-up or wider repaint based on the existing finish.
zh: Ellis 会在范围中区分修补准备和刷漆，并讨论局部补漆还是扩大重刷。不保证完全无痕匹配。
我们会在报价中列明修补准备和刷漆工作，并根据现有饰面，与您沟通局部补漆或扩大重刷的方案。

en: Surface resealing is not membrane replacement or a guaranteed leak cure.
Surface resealing renews visible joints; membrane faults need assessment and a separate waterproofing repair scope.
zh: 表面重新密封不等同于更换防水层，也不保证治好漏水。
表面重新密封用于更新可见接缝；防水层问题需要检查，并另行确定防水维修范围。

en: Keep the screen fault separate when asking Ellis to assess the bathroom.
Tell us what needs repair in your shower area.
zh: 请在咨询浴室评估时，单独说明淋浴屏的故障。
告诉我们淋浴区需要维修的问题。

en: scope and evidence limits
repair scope and completed work
zh: 范围与证据限制
维修内容与完工情况

en: A repair quote covers the agreed work, not an inspection or bond outcome.
We provide a written quote for the repairs you approve.
zh: 维修报价仅涵盖约定工作，不保证检查或押金结果。
我们会为您认可的维修项目提供书面报价。

en: scope, evidence limits and related service
repair scope, completed work and related service
zh: 范围、证据限制及相关服务
维修内容、完工情况及相关服务
